observations_and_decisions.observation: The primary source's second proof uses alternating sums of powers; the published Section 4 restricts its conclusion for repeated roots.
observations_and_decisions.decision: Prove the alternating substitution operator kills all polynomials modulo (X-1)^n, then use a polynomial inverse to f modulo this ideal. This avoids real-root and multiplicity assumptions.

observations_and_decisions.observation: Coprimality of f and X-1 follows exactly from f(1) != 0, giving the required inverse by Bezout.
observations_and_decisions.decision: Use Mathlib polynomial coprimality and composition to prove the uniform regular theorem; treat f(1)=0 termwise only for the cleared polynomial.

observations_and_decisions.observation: The common denominator evaluates to f(1)^(n+1), so cancellation cannot remove any X-1 factor on the intended domain.
observations_and_decisions.decision: Prove the exact cleared-versus-reduced equivalence for every exponent m, using RatFunc.num and its cross-multiplication identity.

observations_and_decisions.observation: The compiled universal theorem includes repeated roots. The source leaves n unquantified and its final sentence omits f(1) != 0.
observations_and_decisions.decision: Restore the domain and formalize per-n and all-n conjectures separately. Use (X+1)^2, whose denominator at 1 is nonzero, as one simultaneous counterexample.

observations_and_decisions.observation: The main theorem, reduced bridge, both conjecture refutations, special radical parameters and Section 4 degree example compiled with only ordinary Mathlib axioms.
observations_and_decisions.decision: Close the substantial Agoh exercise, preserve the source audit and failed elaborations, and select the next primary-source Markov request without beginning that campaign.
